text:
Amy T.: FYI I'm opening a PR with a prod overlay Terraform change — migrating a subset of secrets from SSM -> Secrets Manager using SSE-KMS and rotation. Want to call out release gating: staging canary + manual approval before prod. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/942 :eyes:

Chris H.: quick q — does this require a rolling restart of pods? any risk of secrets being briefly unavailable?

Amy T.: No downtime expected. Plan is: create new secrets in SM, update k8s manifests to reference new secret provider (external-secrets), rollout via canary label to 2 pods in staging, smoke test, then promote. We'll leave old SSM entries for 24h then delete.

Suresh P.: Left a couple inline comments on the PR. Main concerns: KMS key policy needs explicit account principals for Dedicated nodes (we hit this before). Also CI flagged terraform fmt + tflint errors. Run `pre-commit run -a` and `terraform fmt -recursive` locally.

Amy T.: Thanks @Suresh. I'll update the key policy and fix fmt. Snippet I'm proposing for SM resource:

```
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "svc_api_token" {
  name       = "svc/api-token-prod"
  description = "API token for svc (prod)"
  kms_key_id = aws_kms_key.secrets.id
  rotation_lambda_arn = aws_lambda_function.rotate_sm_secret.arn
  tags = {
    env = "prod"
    owner = "svc-team"
  }
}
```

We'll reference the secret ARN in the external-secrets CR and feature-flag the new provider in the deployment.

Lee M.: We should gate this in the release pipeline: add a manual approval step after the staging plan + apply, and a smoke-test job that curls the health endpoint and validates the secret-backed config (200 + contains "featureX":true). I'll add a small job to the pipeline template.

Infra Checker Bot: `terraform plan` (staging overlay) — 2 to add, 1 to change. Plan: https://ci.redwood.ai/plans/3872 (requires apply).

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline for infra-changes/942 triggered by @Amy T. Waiting on manual approval: staging-canary-verify.

Amy T.: OK I'll push fixes in the next hour and add the pipeline gate. Ping @SRE and @ops for post-promote alerts+runbook. Target promote: Friday 09:00 PT if all green. :thumbsup:
